items.title: 上網先找Muse？花旗估2030年替Meta帶來逾270億美元年營收
items.title_en: Search the Web with Muse First? Citi Projects Over $27 Billion Annual Revenue for Meta by 2030
paras: 花旗(C-US)看好Meta(META-US)旗下AI助理Muse成為使用者上網的新入口，預估2030年可為Meta帶來逾270億美元年營收。隨著下載量與使用頻率提升，花旗認為，Muse有望憑藉先行者優勢，在新興個人AI代理市場搶占重要地位。
Muse於9月8日推出，累計下載量已突破660萬次，每日活躍使用者達180萬人。花旗指出，新的應用情境陸續出現，加上Meta加強推廣，正帶動產品普及與使用者參與度，讓Muse逐漸成為協助人們搜尋、比較商品及完成線上交易的入口。
花旗預估，到2030年，Muse每年可創造約230億美元交易相關營收，以及約45億美元訂閱營收。這也意味交易服務將是主要收入來源，商業潛力不僅限於向使用者收取訂閱費。
對Meta而言，Muse是將AI個人代理帶向大眾市場的核心產品。公司希望藉此開拓訂閱與商務收入，同時加深使用者在旗下生態系的參與程度，讓AI從偶爾使用的工具，逐漸成為日常生活的一部分。
花旗表示，Muse位居Meta的AI願景核心，目標是融入使用者每天的生活。隨著個人代理能協助處理更多上網活動，這類產品正成為新的網路入口，而Muse的先行優勢可能是競爭關鍵。
不過，競爭對手也積極布局。OpenAI的ChatGPT Dots、Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Gemini，以及Anthropic的Claude，都在擴大AI代理產品布局，爭奪被視為下一個主要消費運算平台的市場。
市場對Muse的期待已反映在股價上。Meta今年以來上漲12.4%，自Muse推出後更累計上漲逾20%，市值逼近2兆美元。花旗的營收預測也凸顯，投資人正關注Meta能否將產品使用熱度轉化為持續收入。
paras_en: Citi (C-US) is bullish on Meta’s (META-US) AI assistant Muse becoming a new entry point for users browsing the web, estimating it could generate more than $27 billion in annual revenue for Meta by 2030. As download volumes and usage frequency rise, Citi believes Muse is poised to leverage its first‑mover advantage to capture a significant share of the emerging personal AI agent market.

Muse was launched on September 8 and has already surpassed 6.6 million cumulative downloads, with daily active users reaching 1.8 million. Citi notes that new use cases are continuously emerging, and Meta’s intensified promotion is driving product adoption and user engagement, gradually turning Muse into a gateway for searching, comparing products, and completing online transactions.

Citi forecasts that by 2030 Muse could generate roughly $23 billion in transaction‑related revenue and about $4.5 billion in subscription revenue each year. This implies that transaction services will be the primary revenue driver, with commercial potential extending beyond merely charging users subscription fees.

For Meta, Muse is the flagship product for bringing AI personal agents to the mass market. The company aims to tap subscription and commerce revenue streams while deepening user participation across its ecosystem, turning AI from an occasional tool into an everyday part of life.

Citi says Muse sits at the core of Meta’s AI vision, with the goal of embedding it into users’ daily routines. As personal agents help handle more online activities, such products are becoming new entry points to the internet, and Muse’s early‑mover advantage could be a key competitive edge.

However, rivals are also moving aggressively. OpenAI’s ChatGPT Dots, Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) Gemini, and Anthropic’s Claude are all expanding their AI agent offerings, vying for what is seen as the next major consumer computing platform market.

Market expectations for Muse are already reflected in Meta’s stock price. The shares have risen 12.4% year‑to‑date and have gained over 20% since Muse’s launch, pushing the market cap close to $2 trillion. Citi’s revenue outlook underscores that investors are watching whether Meta can convert product enthusiasm into sustained earnings.

items.title: 關稅擋不住進口！美國8月貿易逆差衝上1056億美元 創逾一年最大
items.title_en: Tariffs Can't Stop Imports! U.S. August Trade Deficit Swells to $105.6 Billion, Largest in Over a Year
paras: 美國8月貿易逆差擴大至1,056億美元，創2025年初以來最大，且超出市場預期。AI建設帶動半導體與設備進口，加上能源成本上升及關稅政策干擾，推升進口額至歷史新高，貿易恐再度拖累第三季經濟成長。不過，強勁內需也顯示消費與企業投資仍具支撐力。
美國商務部周二(6日)公布，8月商品與服務貿易逆差較前月擴大13.7%，高於市場預估的約1,020億美元，7月逆差則修正為928億美元。8月進口月增4.3%至4,208億美元，出口僅增1.4%至3,152億美元，成長速度明顯落後。

AI建設拉動進口 半導體增額創紀錄

8月商品進口月增5.3%至3,422億美元，商品出口增加2.2%至2,057億美元。經通膨調整後，商品貿易逆差擴大至1,147億美元，為2025年3月以來最大。
包含電腦及周邊、半導體與電信設備的資本財進口，較前月增加62億美元。其中，半導體進口增加24億美元，創單月增額紀錄，民用飛機與電信設備進口也上升，反映AI投資熱潮持續仰賴海外供應。
包含石油及石油產品的工業原料進口增加91億美元，出口增加63億美元，其中原油出口增加20億美元。非貨幣性黃金進出口也同步增加。相較之下，服務出口大致持平，受訪美旅客支出降至2023年8月以來最低拖累。
美國第二季內需增速創逾三年半最快，消費與AI相關設備投資強勁。8月消費支出及核心資本財訂單、出貨數據顯示，這股動能延續至第三季，企業則持續依靠進口滿足需求。

貿易恐續拖累GDP 關稅未阻進口攀升

貿易已連續三季拖累美國國內生產毛額(GDP)，經濟學家估計，第三季拖累幅度可能達2.5個百分點。最新數據公布前，亞特蘭大聯準銀行GDPNow模型估計，淨出口將拉低第三季GDP成長率2.59個百分點，將是2025年初以來最大拖累。
不過，市場對第三季經濟成長率的預估多高於年率3%，預期消費支出可抵銷進口帶來的拖累，優於第二季的2.2%。
川普主張加徵關稅有助縮小逆差，但進口仍持續攀升。關稅變動、戰爭引發的油價波動及供應鏈挑戰，也使未經通膨調整的每月貿易數據劇烈起伏。
分國別來看，美國對加拿大商品逆差擴大至2025年初以來最高。8月貿易談判破局後，兩國企業搶在關稅生效前加速出貨；美國8月22日起對數十億美元加拿大商品課徵50%關稅，加拿大隨後反制。美國對墨西哥、越南的商品逆差均小幅擴大至新高，對半導體重要供應地台灣的逆差也增加。
paras_en: U.S. August trade deficit widened to $105.6 billion, the biggest since early 2025 and above market expectations. AI build‑out drove semiconductor and equipment imports, while higher energy costs and tariff policy disruptions pushed total imports to a historic high, threatening to again drag down third‑quarter economic growth. Nevertheless, strong domestic demand shows consumption and corporate investment remain supportive.

The U.S. Department of Commerce reported on Tuesday (the 6th) that the goods‑and‑services trade deficit for August expanded 13.7% from the prior month, exceeding the market forecast of roughly $102 billion; the July deficit was revised to $92.8 billion. August imports rose 4.3% month‑over‑month to $420.8 billion, while exports increased only 1.4% to $315.2 billion, a clearly slower growth rate.

AI construction pulled imports higher, with semiconductor imports hitting a record increase. August goods imports rose 5.3% month‑over‑month to $342.2 billion, while goods exports grew 2.2% to $205.7 billion. After inflation adjustment, the goods trade deficit expanded to $114.7 billion, the largest since March 2025.

Imports of capital goods—including computers and peripherals, semiconductors and telecom equipment—rose by $6.2 billion from the prior month. Semiconductor imports alone jumped $2.4 billion, setting a new single‑month increase record, while civil aircraft and telecom equipment imports also rose, reflecting the continued reliance on overseas supply for the AI investment boom.

Imports of industrial raw materials, including oil and petroleum products, increased by $9.1 billion, while exports rose $6.3 billion, with crude oil exports up $2.0 billion. Non‑monetary gold imports and exports also grew. By contrast, services exports were roughly flat, weighed down by U.S. visitor spending falling to its lowest level since August 2023.

U.S. domestic demand in the second quarter grew at the fastest pace in more than three and a half years, with strong consumer spending and AI‑related equipment investment. August consumer outlays and core capital‑goods orders and shipments indicate this momentum will carry into the third quarter, as firms continue to rely on imports to meet demand.

Trade has been a drag on U.S. gross domestic product (GDP) for three consecutive quarters, and economists estimate the third‑quarter drag could reach 2.5 percentage points. Ahead of the latest data release, the Atlanta Fed’s GDPNow model projected that net exports would shave 2.59 percentage points off third‑quarter GDP growth, the biggest drag since early 2025.

However, market forecasts for third‑quarter GDP growth are generally above an annualized 3%, with expectations that consumer spending will offset the import‑related drag, improving on the second quarter’s 2.2% rate.

Former President Trump argues that higher tariffs help narrow the deficit, yet imports keep climbing. Tariff changes, war‑driven oil‑price volatility and supply‑chain challenges also cause unadjusted monthly trade figures to swing sharply.

By country, the U.S. deficit with Canada rose to its highest level since early 2025. After trade talks broke down in August, firms in both nations rushed to ship goods before tariffs took effect; the U.S. imposed a 50% tariff on billions of dollars of Canadian goods starting August 22, prompting a Canadian retaliation. Deficits with Mexico and Vietnam also edged higher to new highs, and the deficit with Taiwan, a key semiconductor supplier, increased as well.

items.title: 美股太旺現金不香了？貨幣基金吸金減速推升美國短債殖利率
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks So Hot Cash Is No Longer Attractive? Money‑Market Funds Slow Inflows Push Up Short‑Term Treasury Yields
paras: 流入貨幣市場基金的資金今年明顯減速，削弱美國短期國庫券的需求，推升其相對殖利率。隨著美國財政部第四季預計大量發行短債，市場關注資金供需失衡是否進一步推高短期融資成本。不過，分析師指出，目前附買回市場運作仍有序，尚未出現明顯資金壓力。
道明證券數據顯示，今年前三季貨幣市場基金淨流入僅1,580億美元，相較之下，2025年全年為8,230億美元，2024年為8,400億美元。今年資金流入速度明顯放緩，也讓短債市場失去部分需求支撐。

資金流入減速 短債投資人要求更高溢酬

貨幣市場基金仍是美國短期國庫券的淨買家，但加碼速度已大幅放慢。美國投資公司協會(ICI)最新數據顯示，截至8月底，這類基金的國庫券持有部位較2025年底增加約4%，去年全年增幅則達18%。
需求降溫已反映在定價上。周一，3個月期國庫券殖利率高於同天期隔夜指數交換(OIS)近10個基點，利差上周曾觸及2024年9月以來最大；6個月期利差則為11.3個基點，上周一度達12.5個基點，為2025年4月以來最高。
OIS反映市場對聯準會(Fed)政策利率路徑的預期。國庫券殖利率高於這項基準，代表投資人要求額外報酬，才願意持有通常以流動性高、風險極低著稱的美國短債。
先鋒集團貨幣市場主管Nafis Smith指出，美股今年強勢，降低投資人轉向現金的意願，也壓抑貨幣市場基金流入。今年以來，標普500指數上漲13%，那斯達克指數上漲18%。

第四季發債潮將至 留意短期融資成本

需求放緩之際，短債供給卻將增加。巴克萊(BCS-US)估計，美國財政部10月將發行約2,250億美元國庫券，11月再發行1,600億美元，大量供給可能進一步推升殖利率。
道明證券美國利率策略主管Gennadiy Goldberg表示，財政部傾向將更多發債集中在期限最短的國庫券，但最大需求來源的成長正在放慢，令人擔憂。
若較高殖利率持續，可能改變短期融資市場的資金流向。當貨幣市場基金將資金從隔夜附買回市場轉向報酬較高的國庫券，同時國庫券發行量增加，融資環境便可能收緊，推升附買回利率，增加交易商及其他市場參與者的籌資成本。
不過，分析師認為現在示警仍嫌太早。第四季通常是貨幣市場基金流入加速的時期，投資人會為年底資金需求、繳稅及投資組合再平衡預先累積現金，有望提供支撐。

升息預期未定 基金縮短期限保留彈性

除了供需變化，利率前景的不確定性也推高短債殖利率。LSEG估算顯示，美國利率期貨目前反映今年還有一次1碼升息，2027年則再升息兩次。
預期利率上升時，貨幣市場基金經理人通常會縮短投資組合期限，讓債券更快到期，以便在Fed升息後，將資金投入殖利率更高的標的。Smith表示，升息預期反覆變動，促使以保全本金為目標的基金偏向持有更短天期資產。
道明數據顯示，貨幣市場基金的加權平均到期天數，已從5月高點42天降至上月的36天，但仍高於2022年的15天低點。
目前，通常最先反映資金壓力的附買回市場仍維持有序。財政部官員也多次強調，穩定幣業者與貨幣市場基金對國庫券的需求依然強勁。不過，Smith指出，短端利率出現市場不習慣的波動，正促使基金縮短期限，並要求更高的風險溢酬。
paras_en: Inflows into money‑market funds have clearly slowed this year, weakening demand for U.S. short‑term Treasury bills and lifting their relative yields. With the Treasury planning a large issuance of short‑term debt in Q4, the market is watching whether the supply‑demand imbalance will further raise short‑term financing costs. Analysts note, however, that the repo market is still operating in an orderly fashion and no obvious funding pressure has emerged yet.

TD Securities data show that net inflows into money‑market funds in the first three quarters of this year total only $158 billion, compared with $823 billion for the full year 2025 and $840 billion for 2024. The slowdown in fund inflows this year has also stripped the short‑bond market of part of its demand support.

Slower inflows, higher premium demanded by short‑bond investors
Money‑market funds remain net buyers of U.S. short‑term Treasuries, but the pace of buying has slowed dramatically. The Investment Company Institute (ICI) reports that as of the end of August, these funds’ Treasury holdings were about 4% higher than at the end of 2025, versus an 18% increase over the whole of last year.

The cooling demand is already reflected in pricing. On Monday, the 3‑month Treasury yield was about 10 basis points above the same‑maturity overnight index swap (OIS), a spread that hit its widest level since September 2024 last week; the 6‑month spread was 11.3 basis points and briefly reached 12.5 basis points last Monday, the highest since April 2025.

OIS rates capture the market’s expectations for the Fed’s policy‑rate path. When Treasury yields sit above this benchmark, investors are demanding extra compensation to hold what are normally ultra‑liquid, ultra‑low‑risk short‑term U.S. bonds.

Nafis Smith, head of money‑market funds at Pioneer Group, said the strong U.S. equity market this year has reduced investors’ appetite to shift into cash, suppressing money‑market fund inflows. Since the start of the year the S&P 500 is up 13% and the Nasdaq 18%.

A Q4 debt‑issuance wave is looming – watch short‑term financing costs
Even as demand eases, short‑term supply is set to rise. Barclays (BCS‑US) estimates the Treasury will issue about $225 billion of bills in October and another $160 billion in November, a surge that could push yields higher.

Gennadiy Goldberg, head of U.S. rates strategy at TD Securities, said the Treasury is likely to concentrate new issuance in the shortest‑dated bills, but the slowdown in growth of the biggest demand source is worrisome.

If higher yields persist, the flow of funds in the short‑term financing market could shift. As money‑market funds move cash from the overnight repo market into higher‑yielding Treasuries while issuance expands, financing conditions could tighten, pushing repo rates up and raising funding costs for dealers and other market participants.

Analysts, however, think it is still too early to sound the alarm. Historically Q4 is a period when money‑market fund inflows accelerate, as investors stockpile cash for year‑end needs, tax payments and portfolio rebalancing, which could provide support.

Rising‑rate expectations remain uncertain, prompting funds to shorten maturities for flexibility
Beyond supply‑demand shifts, uncertainty about the rate outlook is also lifting short‑term Treasury yields. LSEG estimates that U.S. rate futures currently price in one more 0.25‑percentage‑point hike this year and two more hikes in 2027.

When rates are expected to rise, money‑market fund managers typically shorten the weighted‑average maturity of their portfolios so bonds mature sooner, allowing them to redeploy cash into higher‑yielding assets after a Fed hike. Smith said the back‑and‑forth on rate‑hike expectations is causing funds focused on preserving principal to favor even shorter‑dated assets.
TD data show the weighted‑average maturity of money‑market fund holdings has fallen from a May peak of 42 days to 36 days last month, though it remains above the 15‑day low seen in 2022.

At present, the repo market – which usually shows funding pressure first – is still orderly. Treasury officials have repeatedly stressed that stable‑coin issuers and money‑market funds continue to demand Treasuries robustly. Still, Smith notes that the unusual volatility in short‑end rates is prompting funds to trim maturities and demand higher risk premiums.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉AI熱潮與油價降溫聯手助攻！主要指數開高 標普500刷新盤中紀錄
paras: 美股周二開盤走高，AI題材熱度回升與企業獲利展望樂觀，帶動科技股上漲，加上油價與美債殖利率回落，標普500指數盤中刷新歷史高點，並朝8月以來首度收盤新高邁進。布蘭特原油回落至每桶98美元附近，緩解市場通膨疑慮，也帶動美債殖利率小幅下滑，支撐美股延續前三個交易日的漲勢。
輝達(NVDA-US)市值逼近6兆美元，超微(AMD-US)執行長蘇姿丰則預期，未來幾年晶片需求將「非常強勁」，進一步提振AI投資信心。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近250點或近 0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近160點或0.6%，標普 500 指數漲近0.5%，費城半導體指數漲逾1.0%，台積電ADR跌近0.3%。
AI交易與募資熱潮持續，加上油價下滑、美債反彈，帶動市場風險偏好回升。標普500指數期貨周二盤前上漲0.4%，有望挑戰8月以來首度收盤新高，那斯達克100指數也可望續創紀錄，輝達(NVDA-US)市值則進一步逼近6兆美元。
《彭博》報導，布蘭特原油跌破每桶98美元，美債殖利率同步回落，美國財政部長貝森特也強調，政府債務規模可以受到控制，緩解近期高油價與高殖利率對市場的壓力。
AI投資仍是支撐股市的主力。據悉，OpenAI正與多家阿拉伯聯合大公國基金洽談，希望引入主要投資者，支持規模300億美元的募資；中國DeepSeek與月之暗面也各自籌集數十億美元。Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)則與Constellation Energy(CEG-US)簽訂核能購電協議，凸顯AI擴張帶動的電力需求。
分析師認為，股市漲勢仍集中於科技業，但強勁獲利、持續的資本支出與充裕資金，可望支撐提供AI設備及基礎設施的企業。另有策略師指出，今年漲勢主要來自獲利成長，而非估值擴張，美國企業財測上修力道仍強，有利行情延續。
歐洲市場同樣回暖，泛歐Stoxx 600指數上漲0.5%，可望迎來一個月來首次連漲三日。歐債價格自近期數十年低點反彈，由先前表現疲弱的法國與義大利領漲；美元兌多數主要貨幣走弱，歐元漲幅則為逾一個月最大。
法國雖有數百所高中因學生抗議而關閉，政治動盪未阻止法債反彈。極右派總統候選人雷朋提出2032年前將赤字降至GDP的3%以下，法國10年期公債較德國同天期利差縮至不到130個基點，低於近期近160個基點的高峰。

items.title: 需求低迷+擔憂AI高估值！華爾街IPO活動驟減  今年新股掛牌首日平均狂跌23%
items.title_en: Weak Demand and AI Valuation Concerns Slash Wall Street IPO Activity; New‑issue Stocks Fall an Average 23% on First Day
paras: 最新數據顯示，華爾街IPO活動已放緩至寥寥無幾，因投資人對新股發行需求低迷，加上市場擔憂估值過高，令原本預估將迎來上市熱潮的這個季度承壓。
Anthropic和OpenAI上市延期也打擊美國股權資本市場的情緒。一家美國大型資產管理公司的股權資本市場負責人說：「現在沒人關心Anthropic以外的任何公司。」
《彭博資訊》上周四(1日)援引知情人士報導，Anthropic打算最快於11月中旬啟動IPO，或在11月9日當週開始正式路演行銷，爭取在11月26日美國節假日前掛牌，最遲不晚於年底。
報導指出，該公司擬在下周三(14日)於舊金山總部舉辦投資者日活動，已向機構投資人發出邀請。 目前，潛在投資者給出1.8萬億至2兆美元估值，募資規模有望追平或超越SpaceX的紀錄。
今年投資銀行業務暢旺在很大程度上得益於SpaceX今年6月的IPO，但市場日益擔憂AI產業下行，以及民眾對資料中心的反對情緒，近幾周IPO市場已趨於枯竭。
投資銀行家還說，投資人日益質疑那些與AI投資熱潮相關企業所獲得的「脫離實際」的估值。
根據BCA Research數據，今年上市的科技公司股價自首個交易日以來平均下跌約23%，進一步加劇市場對於銀行為爭取承銷業務而對交易定價過高的擔憂。
paras_en: The latest data show that Wall Street IPO activity has slowed to a trickle, as investors show weak demand for new‑issue offerings and the market worries about overly high valuations, putting pressure on a quarter that had been expected to spark an IPO boom.

The postponements of Anthropic and OpenAI’s listings have also dampened sentiment in the U.S. equity capital market. A senior executive overseeing equity capital markets at a large U.S. asset manager said, “Right now, nobody cares about any company except Anthropic.”

Bloomberg reported last Thursday (the 1st) that, according to sources, Anthropic plans to launch its IPO as early as mid‑November, possibly beginning its roadshow the week of November 9 and aiming to list before the U.S. holiday on November 26, but no later than the end of the year.

The report noted that the company intends to hold an investor‑day event at its headquarters in San Francisco next Wednesday (the 14th) and has already invited institutional investors. Potential investors are valuing the firm between $1.8 trillion and $2 trillion, with a fundraising target that could match or exceed SpaceX’s record.

This year’s robust investment‑banking business has largely been driven by SpaceX’s June IPO, but growing worries about a downturn in the AI sector and public opposition to data‑center projects have left the IPO market drying up in recent weeks.
Bankers also said investors are increasingly questioning the “detached from reality” valuations that companies riding the AI hype have received.

According to BCA Research, technology companies that went public this year have seen their shares fall about 23% on average since the first day of trading, further fueling concerns that banks may be over‑pricing deals to win underwriting mandates.

items.title: 金管會釋利多！擴大保險業「健康福祉事業」投資範疇 保單脫鉤、非上市櫃公司可100%控股
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission Announces Positive Move: Expands Insurance Industry’s Investment Scope in Health and Welfare Business, Allows Full Ownership of Non‑Listed Companies and Decouples Policies
paras: 為加速壽險資金轉型並因應超高齡社會需求，金管會保險局今(6)日發布最新令釋，全面放寬保險業投資「健康福祉事業」之限制。本次修法最大亮點在於徹底解開投資標的與「保單業務(核保、理賠、給付)」連結的硬性限制，未來服務對象不再侷限於保戶；同時針對非上市櫃健康事業，保險業最高可持股達 100%，盼引導壽險資金注入產業，構建全齡金融與健康生態圈。
保險局副局長蔡火炎表示，本次法令修正主要基於三大核心考量，首先，隨人口高齡化，民眾對健康管理與長照之需求急遽增加；第二，舊制要求投資事業必須與保單給付或核保理賠強行連結，致使業者投資彈性大受限制；新制實施後，服務客群可擴及一般大眾。第三，希望引導保險業從傳統「事後損害填補」，延伸至事前的「健康促進、疾病預防」及事後的「長照與生活支持」。
政策即日起生效，金管會並將健康福祉事業劃分為五大核心領域，包括健康管理及健康促進(含健檢、藥局通路)、健康醫療科技及數位應用、長期照顧及全齡友善服務(含機構管顧、輔具服務)、健康飲食及營養支持及健康福祉整合平台。
針對壽險業者的投資布局，蔡火炎透露，經初步瞭解，目前業者投資意願最高的領域集中於健康管理顧問、藥局通路及長照輔助服務。
在資金投資上限與股權規範上，金管會釐清三大情境：
保險局提醒，住宿式長照機構與日照中心因屬衛福部特定許可機構，不在本次開放投資範疇內。
不過，外界擔憂龐大保險資金是否會壟斷國內藥局與健檢市場，保險局強調，審核的核心關注點在於「跨專業的營運風險控制」。
蔡火炎指出，健康福祉產業非保險業者本業，保險公司提出申請案時，金管會將嚴審其是否具備專業技術與相符的經營團隊，以確保保險資金運用的安全性、流動性與收益性，兼顧社會觀感與保戶權益。
paras_en: To accelerate the transformation of life‑insurance capital and meet the needs of an ultra‑aged society, the Financial Supervisory Commission’s Insurance Bureau issued a new order today (the 6th), fully relaxing restrictions on insurance‑industry investments in “health and welfare businesses.” The key highlight of the amendment is the complete removal of the hard link between investment targets and “policy business (underwriting, claims, payouts),” meaning future service targets will no longer be limited to policyholders; at the same time, for non‑listed health enterprises, insurers may now hold up to 100% of the equity, aiming to channel life‑insurance funds into the sector and build an all‑age financial and health ecosystem.

Insurance Bureau Deputy Director Cai Huoyan said the regulatory revision is based on three core considerations: first, as the population ages, demand for health management and long‑term care is soaring; second, the old rules forced investment projects to be tightly tied to policy payouts or underwriting claims, severely limiting investment flexibility; under the new regime, the customer base can expand to the general public. Third, the goal is to shift insurers from traditional “post‑loss compensation” toward proactive “health promotion, disease prevention” and, subsequently, “long‑term care and life support.”

The policy takes effect immediately, and the FSC categorizes health and welfare businesses into five core domains: health management and promotion (including health checks and pharmacy channels), health‑care technology and digital applications, long‑term care and all‑age friendly services (including institutional consulting and assistive‑device services), health nutrition and dietary support, and integrated health‑welfare platforms.

Regarding the investment layout of life‑insurance firms, Cai Huoyan disclosed that, based on preliminary surveys, the areas with the highest investment interest are health‑management consulting, pharmacy channels, and long‑term‑care assistance services.
The FSC clarified three scenarios concerning investment caps and equity rules.

The Insurance Bureau reminded that residential long‑term‑care facilities and day‑care centers, being institutions licensed by the Ministry of Health and Welfare, are not included in the newly opened investment scope.

However, concerns have been raised that massive insurance capital could dominate domestic pharmacy and health‑check markets; the bureau emphasized that the core focus of review is “cross‑professional operational risk control.”

Cai Huoyan noted that the health‑welfare industry is not the core business of insurers. When an insurance company submits an application, the FSC will rigorously assess whether it possesses the requisite professional expertise and an appropriate management team, to ensure the safety, liquidity and profitability of insurance‑fund usage while balancing public perception and policyholder interests.

items.title: 高盛警告：多重市場事件罕見交會 三星電子短期股價波動恐加劇
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Warns: Rare Convergence of Multiple Market Events May Amplify Short-Term Volatility in Samsung Electronics Stock
paras: 高盛分析師 Heather Oh 在最新發布的客戶報告發出稱，周四(8日)將出現多個市場事件同時發生的罕見局面，並使得南韓科技巨頭三星電子股價承受異常劇烈的波動壓力。
Oh 在報告中特別指出：「第三季初步財報 + 半導體 ETF 權重調整帶來的潛在機械性賣壓 + 選擇權到期 + 庫藏股回購計畫結束的組合，可能會引發三星電子近期的波動加劇，特別是在 10 月 8 日當天。」
這波賣壓主要源於資金面的結構性調整。高盛指出，合計資產管理規模約 19 兆韓元(約 140 億美元)的 7 檔半導體 ETF 定於 10 月 8 日進行權重調整。
受到持股上限限制，三星預計將面臨資金淨流出；相對地，SK 海力士、SK Square 以及 Isu Petasys、Wonik IPS、Hanmi Semi 等設備廠，則將接收相應的資金流入，形成相對應的機械性買盤。此外，三星規模 15 兆韓元的庫藏股回購計畫即將完結，意味著市場失去了每日穩定的買盤支撐。
外資在事件發生前已連續 5 個交易日淨賣超三星，累計賣超金額達 26 億美元，且避險基金也維持偏賣方的操作傾向。
在基本面與業績預估方面，高盛將三星 2026 年第三季營業利潤預估下修 5% 至 106 兆韓元(與市場共識的 105.5 兆韓元基本相符)，調降的主因在於韓元走強。
儘管下修獲利目標，高盛對三星的營運基本面仍持正面看法。Oh 引述高盛全球投資研究部(GIR)的觀點指出：「高盛研究部認為，100 兆韓元以上的營業利潤受到堅實的 DRAM 與 NAND 基本面支撐，其中 HBM 的成長表現最為亮眼。」
受惠於 HBM4 量產升溫，預估第三季 HBM 位元出貨量將季增近 50%；相對地，傳統 DRAM 由於新增產能優先分配給 HBM 且庫存有限，位元成長表現則大致持平。
針對短期市場波動過後的情勢，Oh 總結稱：「外資是否重新流入，以及公司能否保持強勁的獲利動能與展望指引，將是未來的關鍵觀察點。」
paras_en: Goldman Sachs analyst Heather Oh warned in a newly released client report that Thursday (the 8th) will see a rare convergence of multiple market events, putting abnormal pressure on the stock price of South Korean tech giant Samsung Electronics.

Oh specifically noted in the report: “The combination of Q3 preliminary earnings, potential mechanical selling pressure from semiconductor ETF weight adjustments, options expirations, and the conclusion of a share buyback program could trigger heightened volatility for Samsung Electronics, especially on October 8.”

This selling pressure stems mainly from a structural adjustment in capital flows. Goldman Sachs pointed out that seven semiconductor ETFs with a total asset management size of about 19 trillion won (approximately $14 billion) are scheduled to adjust their weights on October 8.

Due to ownership caps, Samsung is expected to face a net outflow of capital; conversely, SK Hynix, SK Square, Isu Petasys, Wonik IPS, Hanmi Semi and other equipment makers will receive corresponding inflows, creating a mechanical buying side. In addition, Samsung’s 15 trillion‑won share buyback program is about to end, meaning the market loses a daily stabilising buying support.
Foreign investors have been net sellers of Samsung for five consecutive trading days before the event, accumulating net sales of $2.6 billion, and hedge funds also remain biased toward selling.

On the fundamentals and earnings outlook, Goldman Sachs trimmed its forecast for Samsung’s Q3 2026 operating profit by 5% to 106 trillion won (roughly in line with the market consensus of 105.5 trillion won), mainly due to a stronger Korean won.

Despite the lower profit target, Goldman Sachs remains positive on Samsung’s operating fundamentals. Oh quoted the Global Investment Research (GIR) view: “Goldman research believes operating profits above 100 trillion won are solidly supported by DRAM and NAND fundamentals, with HBM growth being the most impressive.”

Benefiting from the ramp‑up of HBM4 production, third‑quarter HBM bit shipments are projected to rise nearly 50% quarter‑over‑quarter; in contrast, traditional DRAM bit growth is expected to be flat as new capacity is prioritized for HBM and inventories remain limited.

Oh concluded that after the short‑term market turbulence, “the key points to watch will be whether foreign capital flows back in and whether the company can sustain strong profit momentum and guidance.”

items.title: 〈台北紡織展〉從世界盃球衣到AI智慧製造 台灣機能性紡織品全球市占約7成
items.title_en: Taipei Textile Expo Showcases From World Cup Jerseys to AI Smart Manufacturing, Taiwan’s Functional Textiles Hold About 70% Global Market Share
paras: 2026台北紡織展（TITAS）今（6）日迎來30周年，經濟部產業發展署主題館首度於南港展覽館1館登場，以「數位整合、高值創新、永續未來」為3大主軸，集結17家紡織、鞋業及袋包業者，展示智慧製造、高值產品及循環經濟等轉型成果，彰顯台灣紡織業以數位與永續轉型、搶攻國際市場的實力。
本次主題館由紡織所、工研院、紡拓會及鞋技中心4大法人共同執行，開幕活動並邀請製衣公會、絲織公會、不織布公會、手提包公會、產業用紡織品協會及台灣精品品牌協會等代表共襄盛舉。
產發署署長邱求慧表示，台灣紡織業擁有完整上中下游供應鏈，國際競爭力高居全球前段班。以114年數據來看，台灣紡織產業產值達3125億元、出口值約62億美元，其中機能性紡織品全球市占率更高達約7成。例如7月落幕的2026世界盃足球賽，遠東新(1402-TW)以回收再生紗打造球衣，獲22支國家隊採用，展現台灣紡織實力。
邱求慧指出，國際市場需求正快速轉變，品牌客戶下單趨向「少量多樣」，交期大幅縮短，對精準碳排數據的要求也日益嚴格，加上資深技術師傅面臨傳承斷層等挑戰。因此，台灣紡織業未來必須靠AI提升生產效率、靠低碳循環取得國際市場入場門票，再透過高值創新拉開與競爭對手的差距。
為加速產業轉型升級，產發署近5年投入近30億元，輔導與補助超過1600家次廠商，帶動產業投資近55億元。經濟部並於114年成立「產業競爭力輔導團」，整合經濟部各單位及勞動部資源，光是今年在紡織領域已完成AI診斷輔導超過350案，培育AI專業人才逾560人次，協助業者加速數位轉型。
展區也呈現業者「用AI把經驗變效率」的轉型成果。深耕鞋材多年的坤璜企業，將上萬筆料號與資深師傅經驗導入AI系統，如今只要拍照並口述需求，3分鐘即可產出報價表，報價效率提升40倍；至誼實業則導入3D虛擬製樣，轉型為品牌研發夥伴，並與HP(HPQ-US)合作開發VR背包、量產1萬個，每年更出口1.2萬個自行車輪袋至奧地利。
paras_en: The 2026 Taipei Textile Expo (TITAS) celebrated its 30th anniversary today (the 6th), with the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Industrial Development Agency debuting its themed pavilion at Nangang Exhibition Hall 1. Centered on “Digital Integration, High‑Value Innovation, Sustainable Future,” the pavilion gathered 17 textile, footwear and bag manufacturers to display smart manufacturing, high‑value products and circular‑economy transformation results, highlighting Taiwan’s textile industry’s strength in digital and sustainable transformation and its push into international markets.

The themed pavilion was jointly executed by four major institutions—the Institute of Textiles, Industrial Technology Research Institute, Textile Development Association and Shoe Technology Center—and the opening ceremony invited representatives from the Garment Association, Silk Weaving Association, Non‑Woven Fabric Association, Handbag Association, Industrial Textile Products Association and Taiwan Boutique Brand Association to participate.

Industrial Development Agency Director Qiu Qiu‑hui said Taiwan’s textile sector boasts a complete upstream‑midstream‑downstream supply chain and ranks among the world’s top in competitiveness. According to 2025 data, the industry’s output value reached NT$312.5 billion with exports of about US$6.2 billion, and functional textiles command roughly 70% of the global market share. For example, at the 2026 World Cup that concluded in July, Far Eastern New (1402‑TW) produced jerseys from recycled yarn, which were adopted by 22 national teams, showcasing Taiwan’s textile prowess.

Qiu noted that international demand is shifting rapidly, with brand customers favoring “small‑batch, diverse” orders, dramatically shortened lead times, and increasingly strict requirements for precise carbon‑emission data. Coupled with a looming gap in senior technical talent, Taiwan’s textile industry must rely on AI to boost production efficiency, adopt low‑carbon circular practices to gain market entry, and leverage high‑value innovation to differentiate from competitors.

To accelerate industry transformation, the agency has invested nearly NT$3 billion over the past five years, assisting and subsidizing more than 1,600 firms and spurring about NT$5.5 billion in industry investment. In 2025 the Ministry of Economic Affairs also established an “Industry Competitiveness Advisory Team,” integrating resources from various ministries and the Labor Ministry. items.title: 金管會釋利多！擴大保險業「健康福祉事業」投資範疇 保單脫鉤、非上市櫃公司可100%控股
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission Announces Positive Move: Expands Insurance Industry’s Investment Scope in Health and Welfare Business, Allows Full Ownership of Non‑Listed Companies and Decouples Policies
paras: 為加速壽險資金轉型並因應超高齡社會需求，金管會保險局今(6)日發布最新令釋，全面放寬保險業投資「健康福祉事業」之限制。本次修法最大亮點在於徹底解開投資標的與「保單業務(核保、理賠、給付)」連結的硬性限制，未來服務對象不再侷限於保戶；同時針對非上市櫃健康事業，保險業最高可持股達 100%，盼引導壽險資金注入產業，構建全齡金融與健康生態圈。
保險局副局長蔡火炎表示，本次法令修正主要基於三大核心考量，首先，隨人口高齡化，民眾對健康管理與長照之需求急遽增加；第二，舊制要求投資事業必須與保單給付或核保理賠強行連結，致使業者投資彈性大受限制；新制實施後，服務客群可擴及一般大眾。第三，希望引導保險業從傳統「事後損害填補」，延伸至事前的「健康促進、疾病預防」及事後的「長照與生活支持」。
政策即日起生效，金管會並將健康福祉事業劃分為五大核心領域，包括健康管理及健康促進(含健檢、藥局通路)、健康醫療科技及數位應用、長期照顧及全齡友善服務(含機構管顧、輔具服務)、健康飲食及營養支持及健康福祉整合平台。
針對壽險業者的投資布局，蔡火炎透露，經初步瞭解，目前業者投資意願最高的領域集中於健康管理顧問、藥局通路及長照輔助服務。
在資金投資上限與股權規範上，金管會釐清三大情境：
保險局提醒，住宿式長照機構與日照中心因屬衛福部特定許可機構，不在本次開放投資範疇內。
不過，外界擔憂龐大保險資金是否會壟斷國內藥局與健檢市場，保險局強調，審核的核心關注點在於「跨專業的營運風險控制」。
蔡火炎指出，健康福祉產業非保險業者本業，保險公司提出申請案時，金管會將嚴審其是否具備專業技術與相符的經營團隊，以確保保險資金運用的安全性、流動性與收益性，兼顧社會觀感與保戶權益。
paras_en: To accelerate the transformation of life‑insurance capital and meet the needs of an ultra‑aged society, the Financial Supervisory Commission’s Insurance Bureau issued a new order today (the 6th), fully relaxing restrictions on insurance‑industry investments in “health and welfare businesses.” The key highlight of the amendment is the complete removal of the hard link between investment targets and “policy business (underwriting, claims, payouts),” meaning future service targets will no longer be limited to policyholders; at the same time, for non‑listed health enterprises, insurers may now hold up to 100% of the equity, aiming to channel life‑insurance funds into the sector and build an all‑age financial and health ecosystem.

Insurance Bureau Deputy Director Cai Huoyan said the regulatory revision is based on three core considerations: first, as the population ages, demand for health management and long‑term care is soaring; second, the old rules forced investment projects to be tightly tied to policy payouts or underwriting claims, severely limiting investment flexibility; under the new regime, the customer base can expand to the general public. Third, the goal is to shift insurers from traditional “post‑loss compensation” toward proactive “health promotion, disease prevention” and, subsequently, “long‑term care and life support.”

The policy takes effect immediately, and the FSC categorizes health and welfare businesses into five core domains: health management and promotion (including health checks and pharmacy channels), health‑care technology and digital applications, long‑term care and all‑age friendly services (including institutional consulting and assistive‑device services), health nutrition and dietary support, and integrated health‑welfare platforms.

Regarding the investment layout of life‑insurance firms, Cai Huoyan disclosed that, based on preliminary surveys, the areas with the highest investment interest are health‑management consulting, pharmacy channels, and long‑term‑care assistance services.
The FSC clarified three scenarios concerning investment caps and equity rules.

The Insurance Bureau reminded that residential long‑term‑care facilities and day‑care centers, being institutions licensed by the Ministry of Health and Welfare, are not included in the newly opened investment scope.

However, concerns have been raised that massive insurance capital could dominate domestic pharmacy and health‑check markets; the bureau emphasized that the core focus of review is “cross‑professional operational risk control.”

Cai Huoyan noted that the health‑welfare industry is not the core business of insurers. When an insurance company submits an application, the FSC will rigorously assess whether it possesses the requisite professional expertise and an appropriate management team, to ensure the safety, liquidity and profitability of insurance‑fund usage while balancing public perception and policyholder interests.

items.title: 〈台北紡織展〉從世界盃球衣到AI智慧製造 台灣機能性紡織品全球市占約7成
items.title_en: Taipei Textile Expo Showcases From World Cup Jerseys to AI Smart Manufacturing, Taiwan’s Functional Textiles Hold About 70% Global Market Share
paras: 2026台北紡織展（TITAS）今（6）日迎來30周年，經濟部產業發展署主題館首度於南港展覽館1館登場，以「數位整合、高值創新、永續未來」為3大主軸，集結17家紡織、鞋業及袋包業者，展示智慧製造、高值產品及循環經濟等轉型成果，彰顯台灣紡織業以數位與永續轉型、搶攻國際市場的實力。
本次主題館由紡織所、工研院、紡拓會及鞋技中心4大法人共同執行，開幕活動並邀請製衣公會、絲織公會、不織布公會、手提包公會、產業用紡織品協會及台灣精品品牌協會等代表共襄盛舉。

邱求慧指出，國際市場需求正快速轉變，品牌客戶下單趨向「少量多樣」，交期大幅縮短，對精準碳排數據的要求也日益嚴格，加上資深技術師傅面臨傳承斷層等挑戰。因此，台灣紡織業未來必須靠AI提升生產效率、靠低碳循環取得國際市場入場門票，再透過高值創新拉開與競爭對手的差距。

展區也呈現業者「用AI把經驗變效率」的轉型成果。深耕鞋材多年的坤璜企業，將上萬筆料號與資深師傅經驗導入AI系統，如今只要拍照並口述需求，3分鐘即可產出報價表，報價效率提升40倍；至誼實業則導入3D虛擬製樣，轉型為品牌研發夥伴，並與HP(HPQ-US)合作開發VR背包、量產1萬個，每年更出口1.2萬個自行車輪袋至奧地利。
paras_en: The 2026 Taipei Textile Expo (TITAS) celebrated its 30th anniversary today (the 6th), with the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Industrial Development Agency debuting its themed pavilion at Nangang Exhibition Hall 1. Centered on “Digital Integration, High‑Value Innovation, Sustainable Future,” the pavilion gathered 17 textile, footwear and bag manufacturers to display smart manufacturing, high‑value products and circular‑economy transformation results, highlighting Taiwan’s textile industry’s strength in digital and sustainable transformation and its push into international markets.

Industrial Development Agency Director Qiu Qiu‑hui said Taiwan’s textile sector boasts a complete upstream‑midstream‑downstream supply chain and ranks among the world’s top in competitiveness. According to 2025 data, the industry’s output value reached NT$312.5 billion with exports of about US$6.2 billion, and functional textiles command roughly 70% of the global market share. For example, at the 2026 World Cup that concluded in July, Far Eastern New (1402‑TW) produced jerseys from recycled yarn, which were adopted by 22 national teams, showcasing Taiwan’s textile prowess.

Qiu noted that international demand is shifting rapidly, with brand customers favoring “small‑batch, diverse” orders, dramatically shortened lead times, and increasingly strict requirements for precise carbon‑emission data. Coupled with a looming gap in senior technical talent, Taiwan’s textile industry must rely on AI to boost production efficiency, adopt low‑carbon circular practices to gain market entry, and leverage high‑value innovation to differentiate from competitors.

To accelerate industry transformation, the agency has invested nearly NT$3 billion over the past five years, assisting and subsidizing more than 1,600 firms and spurring about NT$5.5 billion in industry investment. In 2025 the Ministry of Economic Affairs also established an “Industry Competitiveness Advisory Team,” integrating resources from various ministries and the Labor Ministry. This year alone, over 350 AI diagnostic projects have been completed in the textile sector, more than 560 AI‑specialized personnel have been trained, and companies have been helped to speed up digital transformation.

items.title: 逾3.7萬「純舊制」勞退申辦自提 每3人就有1人搶「卡位」退休紅利
items.title_en: More Than 37,000 Pure Old‑Plan Workers Apply for Voluntary Contributions, About One in Three Grab the Retirement Bonus Slot
paras: 勞工退休金條例施行細則於2026年7月15日修正發布後，開放純舊制勞工自願提繳退休金，並允許符合退休條件者經勞雇協商提前結算舊制退休金存入個人專戶。勞動部6日公布最新數據指出，開放以來申辦情況極為踴躍，截至8月31日止已有超過3.7萬位純舊制勞工申請自願提繳，佔推估總人數逾32%，帶動整體自願提繳率提升2個百分點以上；同時截至9月30日止，已有200家事業單位與666位勞工合意結存近21億元退休金，展現強勁政策效益。
勞動部表示，此次法規修正旨在協助適用純舊制之勞工完善退休規劃。統計顯示，2025年12月推估之純舊制勞工人數約為11.5萬人，新制上路短短一個多月，即吸引3.7萬餘名純舊制勞工響應自提，相當於每3位純舊制勞工就有1人選擇自提，顯見廣大勞工對自我退休保障之重視。
在合意結存舊制退休金方面，截至2026年9月30日止，已有200家事業單位與666位勞工完成勞雇協商，將退休金結算並存入個人專戶，總結存金額高達20.99億元，平均每位勞工結算金額約為315萬餘元。其中結算規模最大之單一事業單位，一次與38位純舊制勞工達成協議，結算金額高達8,700萬餘元，顯見勞雇雙方對於提前結算制度之肯定與信任。
除了純舊制勞工外，勞動部特別提醒事業單位，切勿忽視選擇新制但保留舊制年資（俗稱「舊轉新」）的資深員工。依據勞工退休金條例規定，「舊轉新」勞工本即可經勞雇合意結清舊制年資並轉入個人專戶。2026年截至8月31日止，已有7,666名「舊轉新」勞工完成結清，總金額約達56.49億元，平均每人結算金額約73萬餘元。勞動部呼籲雇主在與純舊制勞工協商時應一視同仁，促進勞雇關係和諧與員工權益。
此外，依據勞工退休準備金提撥及管理辦法第9條規定，事業單位於給付相關退休金且無後續法定支付義務後，得向當地主管機關申請領回準備金賸餘款。2026年截至8月31日止，已有2,223家事業單位辦理專戶註銷，成功領回約41.62億元賸餘款。其中單一事業單位最高領回高達2.6455億元，此舉能為企業注入一筆可彈性運用之活水資金，創造勞雇雙贏局面。
勞動部補充說明，為協助勞雇雙方了解新制流程，已設置「勞退純舊制勞工自願提繳及提前結存退休金」專區，提供協議書範本、常見問答及法令解釋等豐富資源。勞雇雙方若有相關疑問，可透過免付費專線1955進行諮詢，及早做好退休規劃準備。
paras_en: After the detailed rules of the Labor Pension Act were revised and released on July 15, 2026, workers under the pure old‑plan were allowed to voluntarily contribute to their pension and, if they meet retirement conditions, to settle their old‑plan pension early through employer‑employee negotiation and deposit it into a personal account. The Ministry of Labor announced on the 6th that the response has been extremely enthusiastic: by August 31, more than 37,000 pure old‑plan workers had applied for voluntary contributions, accounting for over 32% of the estimated total, pushing the overall voluntary contribution rate up by more than two percentage points. By September 30, 200 enterprises and 666 workers had mutually agreed to settle nearly NT$2.1 billion of pension funds, demonstrating strong policy impact.

The Ministry said the regulatory amendment aims to help pure old‑plan workers improve their retirement planning. Statistics show that the estimated number of pure old‑plan workers in December 2025 was about 115,000. In just over a month since the new system launched, more than 37,000 pure old‑plan workers have responded to the voluntary contribution option – roughly one out of every three pure old‑plan workers – indicating a high level of concern for self‑secured retirement.

Regarding mutually agreed settlements of old‑plan pensions, by September 30, 2026, 200 enterprises and 666 workers had completed employer‑employee negotiations, settling and depositing the pension into personal accounts for a total of NT$20.99 billion, an average of about NT$3.15 million per worker. The largest single enterprise settled with 38 pure old‑plan workers at once, amounting to more than NT$87 million, showing strong confidence and trust in the early settlement system from both sides.

In addition to pure old‑plan workers, the Ministry specifically reminded enterprises not to overlook senior staff who have switched to the new plan but retained old‑plan service years (commonly called “old‑to‑new”). Under the Labor Pension Act, “old‑to‑new” workers can also settle their old‑plan service years by mutual agreement and transfer the amount to a personal account. By August 31, 2026, 7,666 “old‑to‑new” workers had completed settlements, totaling about NT$5.649 billion, an average of roughly NT$730,000 per person. The Ministry urged employers to treat pure old‑plan workers and “old‑to‑new” workers equally in negotiations to promote harmonious labor relations and protect employee rights.

Furthermore, according to Article 9 of the Regulations on the Allocation and Management of Labor Retirement Preparation Funds, enterprises that have paid the relevant pension and have no further statutory payment obligations may apply to the local authority to reclaim surplus preparation funds. By August 31, 2026, 2,223 enterprises had closed their special accounts and successfully reclaimed about NT$4.162 billion in surplus. The highest single‑enterprise reclamation reached NT$2.6455 billion, providing companies with flexible liquid capital and creating a win‑win situation for both labor and management.

The Ministry added that to help both parties understand the new system’s procedures, it has set up a dedicated “Voluntary Contributions and Early Settlement for Pure Old‑Plan Workers” portal, offering template agreements, FAQs, and legal interpretations. Employers and employees with questions can consult the toll‑free hotline 1955 for free advice and prepare their retirement plans early.

items.title: 信義區周慶開打 新光三越：消費者更愛買體驗和生活升級
items.title_en: Xinyi District Anniversary Sale Kicks Off Shin Kong Mitsukoshi: Consumers Prefer Buying Experiences and Lifestyle Upgrades
paras: 新光三越台北信義新天地周年慶將於10月15日盛大開打，一口氣集結超過千家品牌、200家以上新品牌和50家以上全台獨家新櫃共同拚買氣，首14日祭出限定滿仟送點優惠；新光三越強調，今年主要的消費趨勢是消費型態正從「買商品」，走向「買體驗、買興趣、買生活升級」，因此，看好「新場域、新話題、新商品」將是成長的三大動能。
新光三越指出，信義店前三季來客成長約5%，並未明顯受北市新商場開出的影響，主要反映展覽快閃、科技新品與收藏經濟 、高階家電、潮流輕奢和大規模改裝SKM MEN’S等新業態帶動。
在此趨勢下，新光三越信義店今年周慶主打「 新場域、新話題、新商品 」三大動能，提出SKM MEN’S一週年 、 日本展 、 寶可夢 30週年 、 animate、 FANATICS 以及美妝 、 3C、 家電 、運動等明星商品，持續放大人潮與買氣。
新光三越表示，消費者追的不只是折扣，更是話題速度，因此，今年首度規劃「TOP 100 MUST BUY」百大必買商品，從「全球爆款首發」、「社群洗版特搜」到「明星同款必搶」，將散落在全球、社群、明星與不同生活領域的流行訊號，整理成一張年度消費趨勢地圖；從「現在最熱賣」一路看到「下一個會紅」，一次掌握2026年度消費趨勢全貌。
paras_en: Shin Kong Mitsukoshi’s Taipei Xinyi New World anniversary celebration will launch in grand style on October 15, gathering more than a thousand brands, over 200 new brands and more than 50 exclusive Taiwan‑only new counters to boost sales. For the first 14 days, a limited‑time promotion offers bonus points for purchases over NT$1,000. The retailer emphasizes that this year’s main consumer trend is shifting from “buying goods” to “buying experiences, interests and lifestyle upgrades,” and sees “new venues, new topics, new products” as the three key growth drivers.

Shin Kong Mitsukoshi notes that visitor traffic at its Xinyi store grew about 5% in the first three quarters, showing no obvious impact from the opening of new malls in the city. The increase is mainly attributed to pop‑up exhibitions, tech新品, the collector economy, high‑end home appliances, trendy affordable luxury, and large‑scale remodels such as SKM MEN’S, which represent new business formats.

Riding this trend, the Xinyi store’s anniversary this year focuses on the three engines of “new venues, new topics, new products,” featuring the one‑year anniversary of SKM MEN’S, a Japan exhibition, the 30th anniversary of Pokémon, animate, FANATICS, as well as star items in beauty, 3C, home appliances and sports, continuously drawing crowds and sales.

Shin Kong Mitsukoshi says consumers are after more than discounts—they chase hot topics. Accordingly, this year it is debuting a “TOP 100 MUST‑BUY” list, compiling the year’s must‑have items from “global breakout launches,” “social‑media buzz picks,” to “celebrity‑approved must‑haves.” The list maps trending signals from around the world, social platforms, celebrities and various lifestyle sectors into a single annual consumer‑trend map, letting shoppers see today’s best‑sellers and anticipate tomorrow’s hits, capturing the full picture of 2026’s consumption trends.

items.title: AI客製化晶片與資料中心互連催油門！Marvell喊2031財年營收最高900億美元較法人共識高逾1倍
items.title_en: Custom AI Chips and Data Center Interconnect Drive Growth! Marvell Projects FY2031 Revenue Up to $90 B, Over Double Analyst Consensus
paras: 2026年10月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Marvell Technology(MRVL-US)在紐約投資人日大幅拉高長期成長目標，預計2031財年營收達700億至900億美元，相較截至2026年1月止的2026財年營收82億美元，規模最高接近11倍，背後兩大成長引擎鎖定AI客製化晶片與資料中心互連。
值得注意的是，根據最新法人共識統計，市場原先預估Marvell 2031財年營收約438億美元。以公司提出的700億至900億美元目標計算，分別較法人原先預期高出約60%及105%；即使採目標區間中間值800億美元計算，也高出法人共識約83%，顯示公司對AI資料中心帶動的長期成長預期明顯高於市場原先估計。
執行長Matt Murphy公布長期目標後，Marvell股價盤中一度上漲7.2%至290.82美元。公司股價2026年以來已累計上漲近250%，目前本益比約為未來12個月預估每股盈餘的50倍，市場對AI業務成長已有相當高的期待。
Marvell這次揭露的長期營收結構，也進一步說明AI資料中心需求如何轉化為公司成長。以2031財年700億至900億美元營收目標的中間值800億美元計算，公司預估其中300億美元將來自客製化晶片業務。Marvell目前客製化晶片客戶包括Alphabet(GOOGL-US)與Amazon(AMZN-US)等大型AI雲端業者。
另一個更大的成長來源則是資料中心互連。Marvell預估2031財年interconnect業務營收將達375億美元，涵蓋資料中心內部以及不同資料中心之間傳輸資料所需的網路連接解決方案。
這也補充了Marvell稍早上調2028年營收預測的原因。公司將2028年營收目標由8月提出的180億美元提高至約200億美元，高於LSEG彙整的分析師平均預期182億美元；從此次投資人日揭露的長期產品結構來看，客製化AI晶片與資料中心互連已成為公司擴大AI資料中心營收的主要方向。

paras_en: On October 6, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) dramatically raised its long‑term growth target at its New York investor day, forecasting FY2031 revenue of $70 billion to $90 billion, roughly 8.5‑to‑11 times its FY2026 revenue of $8.2 billion (as of January 2026). The two main growth engines are custom AI chips and data‑center interconnect.

Notably, the latest consensus among sell‑side analysts had originally estimated Marvell’s FY2031 revenue at about $43.8 billion. The company’s $70‑$90 billion range is therefore roughly 60% to 105% higher than that consensus; even the midpoint of $80 billion is about 83% above the prior estimate, indicating Marvell’s expectations for AI‑driven data‑center growth far exceed market expectations.

After CEO Matt Murphy announced the long‑term target, Marvell’s stock rose as much as 7.2% intraday to $290.82. The share price has climbed nearly 250% since the start of 2026, and it now trades at roughly 50 times forward earnings for the next 12 months, reflecting strong market optimism about the AI business.

The disclosed long‑term revenue structure also clarifies how AI data‑center demand translates into company growth. Using the midpoint of the FY2031 target ($80 billion), Marvell estimates $30 billion will come from its custom chip business. Current custom‑chip customers include major AI cloud players such as Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US).

A larger growth source is data‑center interconnect. Marvell projects FY2031 interconnect revenue of $37.5 billion, covering networking solutions needed for data transfer within a data center and between different data centers.

This also explains why Marvell earlier raised its FY2028 revenue outlook. The company lifted its FY2028 target from the $18 billion announced in August to roughly $20 billion, above the LSEG‑averaged analyst forecast of $18.2 billion. From the product mix revealed at the investor day, custom AI chips and data‑center interconnect are now the primary avenues for expanding AI data‑center revenue.

items.title: 美光6億美元和解Netlist專利訴訟取得HBM等記憶體技術5年授權
items.title_en: Micron to Pay $600 Million Settlement with Netlist, Secures 5‑Year License for HBM and Other Memory Technologies
paras: 2026年10月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美光Micron Technology(MU-US)將支付6億美元，與記憶體技術公司Netlist(NLST-US)就記憶體晶片專利爭議達成和解，並取得包含高頻寬記憶體(HBM)技術在內的專利組合5年授權。
依據協議，美光未來5年將每季支付Netlist 3,000萬美元授權費，合計6億美元。雙方此次和解延續多年專利爭議，Netlist先前已於2024年在美國德州聯邦法院取得4.45億美元的專利侵權賠償判決。
隨著HBM成為AI加速器的重要記憶體，美光與Netlist的專利爭議近期也進一步延伸至AI供應鏈。Netlist今年9月向美國國際貿易委員會(ITC)提出新的侵權申訴，尋求阻止涉及相關專利的美光晶片進口，而這些晶片被應用於Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、NVIDIA(NVDA-US)及Broadcom(AVGO-US)的AI運算產品。
Netlist執行長C.K. Hong表示，與美光達成協議進一步驗證公司AI記憶體技術的價值，公司仍將持續保護智慧財產權並投入下一代產品開發。美光截至原文發布時尚未回應這項和解協議。
Netlist今年8月也與Samsung Electronics(005930-KR)就另一項記憶體專利爭議達成和解，此前Netlist已在德州針對Samsung取得合計4.21億美元的專利賠償判決。

paras_en: On October 6, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Micron Technology (MU‑US) will pay $600 million to settle a patent dispute with memory‑technology company Netlist (NLST‑US) and obtain a five‑year license to a portfolio that includes high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) technology.

Under the agreement, Micron will pay Netlist a quarterly royalty of $30 million for the next five years, totaling $600 million. The settlement ends a long‑running patent fight; Netlist previously won a $445 million infringement judgment in the U.S. District Court in Texas in 2024.

As HBM becomes a key memory for AI accelerators, the Micron‑Netlist dispute has recently spilled over into the AI supply chain. In September, Netlist filed a new infringement complaint with the U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) seeking to block imports of Micron chips that use the disputed patents, chips that are employed in AI computing products from Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US).

Netlist CEO C.K. Hong said that reaching an agreement with Micron further validates the value of the company’s AI memory technology; Netlist will continue to protect its intellectual property and invest in next‑generation product development. Micron had not responded to the settlement at the time of publication.

In August of this year, Netlist also settled another memory‑patent dispute with Samsung Electronics (005930‑KR); previously Netlist had secured a $421 million patent‑damage judgment against Samsung in Texas.

items.title: 上網先找Muse？花旗估2030年替Meta帶來逾270億美元年營收
items.title_en: Search the Web with Muse First? Citi Projects Over $27 Billion Annual Revenue for Meta by 2030
paras: 花旗(C-US)看好Meta(META-US)旗下AI助理Muse成為使用者上網的新入口，預估2030年可為Meta帶來逾270億美元年營收。隨著下載量與使用頻率提升，花旗認為，Muse有望憑藉先行者優勢，在新興個人AI代理市場搶占重要地位。
Muse於9月8日推出，累計下載量已突破660萬次，每日活躍使用者達180萬人。花旗指出，新的應用情境陸續出現，加上Meta加強推廣，正帶動產品普及與使用者參與度，讓Muse逐漸成為協助人們搜尋、比較商品及完成線上交易的入口。
花旗預估，到2030年，Muse每年可創造約230億美元交易相關營收，以及約45億美元訂閱營收。這也意味交易服務將是主要收入來源，商業潛力不僅限於向使用者收取訂閱費。
對Meta而言，Muse是將AI個人代理帶向大眾市場的核心產品。公司希望藉此開拓訂閱與商務收入，同時加深使用者在旗下生態系的參與程度，讓AI從偶爾使用的工具，逐漸成為日常生活的一部分。
花旗表示，Muse位居Meta的AI願景核心，目標是融入使用者每天的生活。隨著個人代理能協助處理更多上網活動，這類產品正成為新的網路入口，而Muse的先行優勢可能是競爭關鍵。
不過，競爭對手也積極布局。OpenAI的ChatGPT Dots、Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Gemini，以及Anthropic的Claude，都在擴大AI代理產品布局，爭奪被視為下一個主要消費運算平台的市場。
市場對Muse的期待已反映在股價上。Meta今年以來上漲12.4%，自Muse推出後更累計上漲逾20%，市值逼近2兆美元。花旗的營收預測也凸顯，投資人正關注Meta能否將產品使用熱度轉化為持續收入。
paras_en: Citi (C-US) is bullish on Meta’s (META-US) AI assistant Muse becoming a new entry point for users browsing the web, estimating it could generate more than $27 billion in annual revenue for Meta by 2030. As download volumes and usage frequency rise, Citi believes Muse is poised to leverage its first‑mover advantage to capture a significant share of the emerging personal AI agent market.

Muse was launched on September 8 and has already surpassed 6.6 million cumulative downloads, with daily active users reaching 1.8 million. Citi notes that new use cases are continuously emerging, and Meta’s intensified promotion is driving product adoption and user engagement, gradually turning Muse into a gateway for searching, comparing products, and completing online transactions.

Citi forecasts that by 2030 Muse could generate roughly $23 billion in transaction‑related revenue and about $4.5 billion in subscription revenue each year. This implies that transaction services will be the primary revenue driver, with commercial potential extending beyond merely charging users subscription fees.

For Meta, Muse is the flagship product for bringing AI personal agents to the mass market. The company aims to tap subscription and commerce revenue streams while deepening user participation across its ecosystem, turning AI from an occasional tool into an everyday part of life.

Citi says Muse sits at the core of Meta’s AI vision, with the goal of embedding it into users’ daily routines. As personal agents help handle more online activities, such products are becoming new entry points to the internet, and Muse’s early‑mover advantage could be a key competitive edge.

However, rivals are also moving aggressively. OpenAI’s ChatGPT Dots, Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) Gemini, and Anthropic’s Claude are all expanding their AI agent offerings, vying for what is seen as the next major consumer computing platform market.

Market expectations for Muse are already reflected in Meta’s stock price. The shares have risen 12.4% year‑to‑date and have gained over 20% since Muse’s launch, pushing the market cap close to $2 trillion. Citi’s revenue outlook underscores that investors are watching whether Meta can convert product enthusiasm into sustained earnings.

items.title: 關稅擋不住進口！美國8月貿易逆差衝上1056億美元 創逾一年最大
items.title_en: Tariffs Can't Stop Imports! U.S. August Trade Deficit Swells to $105.6 Billion, Largest in Over a Year
paras: 美國8月貿易逆差擴大至1,056億美元，創2025年初以來最大，且超出市場預期。AI建設帶動半導體與設備進口，加上能源成本上升及關稅政策干擾，推升進口額至歷史新高，貿易恐再度拖累第三季經濟成長。不過，強勁內需也顯示消費與企業投資仍具支撐力。
美國商務部周二(6日)公布，8月商品與服務貿易逆差較前月擴大13.7%，高於市場預估的約1,020億美元，7月逆差則修正為928億美元。8月進口月增4.3%至4,208億美元，出口僅增1.4%至3,152億美元，成長速度明顯落後。

AI建設拉動進口 半導體增額創紀錄

8月商品進口月增5.3%至3,422億美元，商品出口增加2.2%至2,057億美元。經通膨調整後，商品貿易逆差擴大至1,147億美元，為2025年3月以來最大。
包含電腦及周邊、半導體與電信設備的資本財進口，較前月增加62億美元。其中，半導體進口增加24億美元，創單月增額紀錄，民用飛機與電信設備進口也上升，反映AI投資熱潮持續仰賴海外供應。
包含石油及石油產品的工業原料進口增加91億美元，出口增加63億美元，其中原油出口增加20億美元。非貨幣性黃金進出口也同步增加。相較之下，服務出口大致持平，受訪美旅客支出降至2023年8月以來最低拖累。
美國第二季內需增速創逾三年半最快，消費與AI相關設備投資強勁。8月消費支出及核心資本財訂單、出貨數據顯示，這股動能延續至第三季，企業則持續依靠進口滿足需求。

貿易恐續拖累GDP 關稅未阻進口攀升

貿易已連續三季拖累美國國內生產毛額(GDP)，經濟學家估計，第三季拖累幅度可能達2.5個百分點。最新數據公布前，亞特蘭大聯準銀行GDPNow模型估計，淨出口將拉低第三季GDP成長率2.59個百分點，將是2025年初以來最大拖累。
不過，市場對第三季經濟成長率的預估多高於年率3%，預期消費支出可抵銷進口帶來的拖累，優於第二季的2.2%。
川普主張加徵關稅有助縮小逆差，但進口仍持續攀升。關稅變動、戰爭引發的油價波動及供應鏈挑戰，也使未經通膨調整的每月貿易數據劇烈起伏。
分國別來看，美國對加拿大商品逆差擴大至2025年初以來最高。8月貿易談判破局後，兩國企業搶在關稅生效前加速出貨；美國8月22日起對數十億美元加拿大商品課徵50%關稅，加拿大隨後反制。美國對墨西哥、越南的商品逆差均小幅擴大至新高，對半導體重要供應地台灣的逆差也增加。
paras_en: U.S. August trade deficit widened to $105.6 billion, the biggest since early 2025 and above market expectations. AI build‑out drove semiconductor and equipment imports, while higher energy costs and tariff policy disruptions pushed total imports to a historic high, threatening to again drag down third‑quarter economic growth. Nevertheless, strong domestic demand shows consumption and corporate investment remain supportive.

The U.S. Department of Commerce reported on Tuesday (the 6th) that the goods‑and‑services trade deficit for August expanded 13.7% from the prior month, exceeding the market forecast of roughly $102 billion; the July deficit was revised to $92.8 billion. August imports rose 4.3% month‑over‑month to $420.8 billion, while exports increased only 1.4% to $315.2 billion, a clearly slower growth rate.

AI construction pulled imports higher, with semiconductor imports hitting a record increase. August goods imports rose 5.3% month‑over‑month to $342.2 billion, while goods exports grew 2.2% to $205.7 billion. After inflation adjustment, the goods trade deficit expanded to $114.7 billion, the largest since March 2025.

Imports of capital goods—including computers and peripherals, semiconductors and telecom equipment—rose by $6.2 billion from the prior month. Semiconductor imports alone jumped $2.4 billion, setting a new single‑month increase record, while civil aircraft and telecom equipment imports also rose, reflecting the continued reliance on overseas supply for the AI investment boom.

Imports of industrial raw materials, including oil and petroleum products, increased by $9.1 billion, while exports rose $6.3 billion, with crude oil exports up $2.0 billion. Non‑monetary gold imports and exports also grew. By contrast, services exports were roughly flat, weighed down by U.S. visitor spending falling to its lowest level since August 2023.

U.S. domestic demand in the second quarter grew at the fastest pace in more than three and a half years, with strong consumer spending and AI‑related equipment investment. August consumer outlays and core capital‑goods orders and shipments indicate this momentum will carry into the third quarter, as firms continue to rely on imports to meet demand.

Trade has been a drag on U.S. gross domestic product (GDP) for three consecutive quarters, and economists estimate the third‑quarter drag could reach 2.5 percentage points. Ahead of the latest data release, the Atlanta Fed’s GDPNow model projected that net exports would shave 2.59 percentage points off third‑quarter GDP growth, the biggest drag since early 2025.

However, market forecasts for third‑quarter GDP growth are generally above an annualized 3%, with expectations that consumer spending will offset the import‑related drag, improving on the second quarter’s 2.2% rate.

Former President Trump argues that higher tariffs help narrow the deficit, yet imports keep climbing. Tariff changes, war‑driven oil‑price volatility and supply‑chain challenges also cause unadjusted monthly trade figures to swing sharply.

By country, the U.S. deficit with Canada rose to its highest level since early 2025. After trade talks broke down in August, firms in both nations rushed to ship goods before tariffs took effect; the U.S. imposed a 50% tariff on billions of dollars of Canadian goods starting August 22, prompting a Canadian retaliation. Deficits with Mexico and Vietnam also edged higher to new highs, and the deficit with Taiwan, a key semiconductor supplier, increased as well.

items.title: 美股太旺現金不香了？貨幣基金吸金減速推升美國短債殖利率
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks So Hot Cash Is No Longer Attractive? Money‑Market Funds Slow Inflows Push Up Short‑Term Treasury Yields
paras: 流入貨幣市場基金的資金今年明顯減速，削弱美國短期國庫券的需求，推升其相對殖利率。隨著美國財政部第四季預計大量發行短債，市場關注資金供需失衡是否進一步推高短期融資成本。不過，分析師指出，目前附買回市場運作仍有序，尚未出現明顯資金壓力。
道明證券數據顯示，今年前三季貨幣市場基金淨流入僅1,580億美元，相較之下，2025年全年為8,230億美元，2024年為8,400億美元。今年資金流入速度明顯放緩，也讓短債市場失去部分需求支撐。

資金流入減速 短債投資人要求更高溢酬

貨幣市場基金仍是美國短期國庫券的淨買家，但加碼速度已大幅放慢。美國投資公司協會(ICI)最新數據顯示，截至8月底，這類基金的國庫券持有部位較2025年底增加約4%，去年全年增幅則達18%。
需求降溫已反映在定價上。周一，3個月期國庫券殖利率高於同天期隔夜指數交換(OIS)近10個基點，利差上周曾觸及2024年9月以來最大；6個月期利差則為11.3個基點，上周一度達12.5個基點，為2025年4月以來最高。
OIS反映市場對聯準會(Fed)政策利率路徑的預期。國庫券殖利率高於這項基準，代表投資人要求額外報酬，才願意持有通常以流動性高、風險極低著稱的美國短債。
先鋒集團貨幣市場主管Nafis Smith指出，美股今年強勢，降低投資人轉向現金的意願，也壓抑貨幣市場基金流入。今年以來，標普500指數上漲13%，那斯達克指數上漲18%。

第四季發債潮將至 留意短期融資成本

需求放緩之際，短債供給卻將增加。巴克萊(BCS-US)估計，美國財政部10月將發行約2,250億美元國庫券，11月再發行1,600億美元，大量供給可能進一步推升殖利率。
道明證券美國利率策略主管Gennadiy Goldberg表示，財政部傾向將更多發債集中在期限最短的國庫券，但最大需求來源的成長正在放慢，令人擔憂。
若較高殖利率持續，可能改變短期融資市場的資金流向。當貨幣市場基金將資金從隔夜附買回市場轉向報酬較高的國庫券，同時國庫券發行量增加，融資環境便可能收緊，推升附買回利率，增加交易商及其他市場參與者的籌資成本。
不過，分析師認為現在示警仍嫌太早。第四季通常是貨幣市場基金流入加速的時期，投資人會為年底資金需求、繳稅及投資組合再平衡預先累積現金，有望提供支撐。

升息預期未定 基金縮短期限保留彈性

除了供需變化，利率前景的不確定性也推高短債殖利率。LSEG估算顯示，美國利率期貨目前反映今年還有一次1碼升息，2027年則再升息兩次。
預期利率上升時，貨幣市場基金經理人通常會縮短投資組合期限，讓債券更快到期，以便在Fed升息後，將資金投入殖利率更高的標的。Smith表示，升息預期反覆變動，促使以保全本金為目標的基金偏向持有更短天期資產。
道明數據顯示，貨幣市場基金的加權平均到期天數，已從5月高點42天降至上月的36天，但仍高於2022年的15天低點。
目前，通常最先反映資金壓力的附買回市場仍維持有序。財政部官員也多次強調，穩定幣業者與貨幣市場基金對國庫券的需求依然強勁。不過，Smith指出，短端利率出現市場不習慣的波動，正促使基金縮短期限，並要求更高的風險溢酬。
paras_en: Inflows into money‑market funds have clearly slowed this year, weakening demand for U.S. short‑term Treasury bills and lifting their relative yields. With the Treasury planning a large issuance of short‑term debt in Q4, the market is watching whether the supply‑demand imbalance will further raise short‑term financing costs. Analysts note, however, that the repo market is still operating in an orderly fashion and no obvious funding pressure has emerged yet.

TD Securities data show that net inflows into money‑market funds in the first three quarters of this year total only $158 billion, compared with $823 billion for the full year 2025 and $840 billion for 2024. The slowdown in fund inflows this year has also stripped the short‑bond market of part of its demand support.

Slower inflows, higher premium demanded by short‑bond investors
Money‑market funds remain net buyers of U.S. short‑term Treasuries, but the pace of buying has slowed dramatically. The Investment Company Institute (ICI) reports that as of the end of August, these funds’ Treasury holdings were about 4% higher than at the end of 2025, versus an 18% increase over the whole of last year.

The cooling demand is already reflected in pricing. On Monday, the 3‑month Treasury yield was about 10 basis points above the same‑maturity overnight index swap (OIS), a spread that hit its widest level since September 2024 last week; the 6‑month spread was 11.3 basis points and briefly reached 12.5 basis points last Monday, the highest since April 2025.

OIS rates capture the market’s expectations for the Fed’s policy‑rate path. When Treasury yields sit above this benchmark, investors are demanding extra compensation to hold what are normally ultra‑liquid, ultra‑low‑risk short‑term U.S. bonds.

Nafis Smith, head of money‑market funds at Pioneer Group, said the strong U.S. equity market this year has reduced investors’ appetite to shift into cash, suppressing money‑market fund inflows. Since the start of the year the S&P 500 is up 13% and the Nasdaq 18%.

A Q4 debt‑issuance wave is looming – watch short‑term financing costs
Even as demand eases, short‑term supply is set to rise. Barclays (BCS‑US) estimates the Treasury will issue about $225 billion of bills in October and another $160 billion in November, a surge that could push yields higher.

Gennadiy Goldberg, head of U.S. rates strategy at TD Securities, said the Treasury is likely to concentrate new issuance in the shortest‑dated bills, but the slowdown in growth of the biggest demand source is worrisome.

If higher yields persist, the flow of funds in the short‑term financing market could shift. As money‑market funds move cash from the overnight repo market into higher‑yielding Treasuries while issuance expands, financing conditions could tighten, pushing repo rates up and raising funding costs for dealers and other market participants.

Analysts, however, think it is still too early to sound the alarm. Historically Q4 is a period when money‑market fund inflows accelerate, as investors stockpile cash for year‑end needs, tax payments and portfolio rebalancing, which could provide support.

Rising‑rate expectations remain uncertain, prompting funds to shorten maturities for flexibility
Beyond supply‑demand shifts, uncertainty about the rate outlook is also lifting short‑term Treasury yields. LSEG estimates that U.S. rate futures currently price in one more 0.25‑percentage‑point hike this year and two more hikes in 2027.

When rates are expected to rise, money‑market fund managers typically shorten the weighted‑average maturity of their portfolios so bonds mature sooner, allowing them to redeploy cash into higher‑yielding assets after a Fed hike. Smith said the back‑and‑forth on rate‑hike expectations is causing funds focused on preserving principal to favor even shorter‑dated assets.
TD data show the weighted‑average maturity of money‑market fund holdings has fallen from a May peak of 42 days to 36 days last month, though it remains above the 15‑day low seen in 2022.

At present, the repo market – which usually shows funding pressure first – is still orderly. Treasury officials have repeatedly stressed that stable‑coin issuers and money‑market funds continue to demand Treasuries robustly. Still, Smith notes that the unusual volatility in short‑end rates is prompting funds to trim maturities and demand higher risk premiums.

paras: 美股周二開盤走高，AI題材熱度回升與企業獲利展望樂觀，帶動科技股上漲，加上油價與美債殖利率回落，標普500指數盤中刷新歷史高點，並朝8月以來首度收盤新高邁進。布蘭特原油回落至每桶98美元附近，緩解市場通膨疑慮，也帶動美債殖利率小幅下滑，支撐美股延續前三個交易日的漲勢。
輝達(NVDA-US)市值逼近6兆美元，超微(AMD-US)執行長蘇姿丰則預期，未來幾年晶片需求將「非常強勁」，進一步提振AI投資信心。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近250點或近 0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近160點或0.6%，標普 500 指數漲近0.5%，費城半導體指數漲逾1.0%，台積電ADR跌近0.3%。
AI交易與募資熱潮持續，加上油價下滑、美債反彈，帶動市場風險偏好回升。標普500指數期貨周二盤前上漲0.4%，有望挑戰8月以來首度收盤新高，那斯達克100指數也可望續創紀錄，輝達(NVDA-US)市值則進一步逼近6兆美元。
《彭博》報導，布蘭特原油跌破每桶98美元，美債殖利率同步回落，美國財政部長貝森特也強調，政府債務規模可以受到控制，緩解近期高油價與高殖利率對市場的壓力。
AI投資仍是支撐股市的主力。據悉，OpenAI正與多家阿拉伯聯合大公國基金洽談，希望引入主要投資者，支持規模300億美元的募資；中國DeepSeek與月之暗面也各自籌集數十億美元。Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)則與Constellation Energy(CEG-US)簽訂核能購電協議，凸顯AI擴張帶動的電力需求。
分析師認為，股市漲勢仍集中於科技業，但強勁獲利、持續的資本支出與充裕資金，可望支撐提供AI設備及基礎設施的企業。另有策略師指出，今年漲勢主要來自獲利成長，而非估值擴張，美國企業財測上修力道仍強，有利行情延續。
歐洲市場同樣回暖，泛歐Stoxx 600指數上漲0.5%，可望迎來一個月來首次連漲三日。歐債價格自近期數十年低點反彈，由先前表現疲弱的法國與義大利領漲；美元兌多數主要貨幣走弱，歐元漲幅則為逾一個月最大。
法國雖有數百所高中因學生抗議而關閉，政治動盪未阻止法債反彈。極右派總統候選人雷朋提出2032年前將赤字降至GDP的3%以下，法國10年期公債較德國同天期利差縮至不到130個基點，低於近期近160個基點的高峰。
不過，分析師提醒，中東衝突尚未解決，油價仍是關鍵變數。《彭博》策略師也指出，美國市場仍圍繞較高潛在成長率、中性利率及政策利率定價，美債殖利率進一步下滑仍面臨阻力。

items.title: 需求低迷+擔憂AI高估值！華爾街IPO活動驟減  今年新股掛牌首日平均狂跌23%
items.title_en: Weak Demand and AI Valuation Concerns Slash Wall Street IPO Activity; New‑issue Stocks Fall an Average 23% on First Day
paras: 最新數據顯示，華爾街IPO活動已放緩至寥寥無幾，因投資人對新股發行需求低迷，加上市場擔憂估值過高，令原本預估將迎來上市熱潮的這個季度承壓。
Anthropic和OpenAI上市延期也打擊美國股權資本市場的情緒。一家美國大型資產管理公司的股權資本市場負責人說：「現在沒人關心Anthropic以外的任何公司。」
《彭博資訊》上周四(1日)援引知情人士報導，Anthropic打算最快於11月中旬啟動IPO，或在11月9日當週開始正式路演行銷，爭取在11月26日美國節假日前掛牌，最遲不晚於年底。
報導指出，該公司擬在下周三(14日)於舊金山總部舉辦投資者日活動，已向機構投資人發出邀請。 目前，潛在投資者給出1.8萬億至2兆美元估值，募資規模有望追平或超越SpaceX的紀錄。
今年投資銀行業務暢旺在很大程度上得益於SpaceX今年6月的IPO，但市場日益擔憂AI產業下行，以及民眾對資料中心的反對情緒，近幾周IPO市場已趨於枯竭。
投資銀行家還說，投資人日益質疑那些與AI投資熱潮相關企業所獲得的「脫離實際」的估值。
根據BCA Research數據，今年上市的科技公司股價自首個交易日以來平均下跌約23%，進一步加劇市場對於銀行為爭取承銷業務而對交易定價過高的擔憂。
paras_en: The latest data show that Wall Street IPO activity has slowed to a trickle, as investors show weak demand for new‑issue offerings and the market worries about overly high valuations, putting pressure on a quarter that had been expected to spark an IPO boom.

The postponements of Anthropic and OpenAI’s listings have also dampened sentiment in the U.S. equity capital market. A senior executive overseeing equity capital markets at a large U.S. asset manager said, “Right now, nobody cares about any company except Anthropic.”

Bloomberg reported last Thursday (the 1st) that, according to sources, Anthropic plans to launch its IPO as early as mid‑November, possibly beginning its roadshow the week of November 9 and aiming to list before the U.S. holiday on November 26, but no later than the end of the year.

The report noted that the company intends to hold an investor‑day event at its headquarters in San Francisco next Wednesday (the 14th) and has already invited institutional investors. Potential investors are valuing the firm between $1.8 trillion and $2 trillion, with a fundraising target that could match or exceed SpaceX’s record.

This year’s robust investment‑banking business has largely been driven by SpaceX’s June IPO, but growing worries about a downturn in the AI sector and public opposition to data‑center projects have left the IPO market drying up in recent weeks.
Bankers also said investors are increasingly questioning the “detached from reality” valuations that companies riding the AI hype have received.

According to BCA Research, technology companies that went public this year have seen their shares fall about 23% on average since the first day of trading, further fueling concerns that banks may be over‑pricing deals to win underwriting mandates.

items.title: SpaceX大漲8%收復IPO價！想重演上市飆漲行情恐得等等
items.title_en: SpaceX surges 8% to regain IPO price! Replicating the post‑IPO rally may have to wait
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US)再度成為美股焦點，昨日股價大漲8%至171美元，較低點反彈近50%，收復首次公開發行(IPO)價格，也讓執行長馬斯克重返兆美元富豪行列。不過，期權市場透露，這波漲勢與6月上市時有項關鍵差異：市場預期的股價波動已明顯下降。
在那斯達克100指數創新高之際，SpaceX也迎來利多。摩根士丹利(MS-US)分析師Adam Jonas日前重申300美元目標價；上周四，獵鷹9號火箭更以不到8小時將四名太空人送抵國際太空站，創下紀錄。
交易熱度同步升溫，昨日期權成交量達170萬口，為30日均量的兩倍，交易金額合計9億美元。其中，買權占100萬口，金額逾6.4億美元。
然而，SpaceX先前連續七周在約10%的價格區間內盤整，隱含波動率已遠低於上市初期。6月掛牌後，股價不到三個完整交易日便從171美元衝破225美元，當時隱含波動率超過110%，如今僅約55%，雖高於上周四不到50%的歷史低點，仍反映市場預期漲跌幅較小。
依昨日收盤期權價格推算，SpaceX在明年7月前觸及225美元的機率不到50%，本月底前觸及185美元的機率則為54%。除非延續最近兩天的急漲速度，否則挑戰新高可能需要更長時間。
Barchart數據也顯示，SpaceX賣權的隱含波動率等於或高於買權，反映市場同樣重視下跌風險。相較之下，輝達(NVDA-US)多個到期日的買權較貴，顯示投資人更擔心錯過漲勢。
儘管如此，SpaceX昨日期權資金流向仍偏多。交易員Charles Moon表示，華爾街似乎從第四季開始加碼，SpaceX與特斯拉(TSLA-US)近期走勢也更同步。ThinkOrSwim數據顯示，兩者30日相關係數為0.66。Jonas則認為，考量成長性後，SpaceX是布局太空與智慧經濟潛力相對便宜的選擇之一。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) is back in the spotlight on U.S. equities, with its stock soaring 8% yesterday to $171, rebounding nearly 50% from its lows and retaking its initial public offering (IPO) price, which also puts CEO Elon Musk back among the trillion‑dollar‑worth billionaires. However, options market data reveal a key difference from the June debut: the market’s expected stock volatility has dropped markedly.

At a time when the Nasdaq‑100 is hitting fresh highs, SpaceX also received a boost. Morgan Stanley (MS-US) analyst Adam Jonas recently reaffirmed a $300 target price; and last Thursday, the Falcon 9 rocket delivered four astronauts to the International Space Station in under eight hours, setting a new record.

Trading enthusiasm rose in tandem, with yesterday’s options volume reaching 1.7 million contracts—twice the 30‑day average—and a total notional value of $900 million. Calls accounted for 1 million contracts, amounting to more than $640 million.

Nevertheless, SpaceX had been consolidating for seven straight weeks within roughly a 10% price band, and its implied volatility (IV) is now far below the levels seen early after the listing. After debuting in June, the stock surged past $225 in less than three full trading days, when IV topped 110%; today it sits around 55%, still above the sub‑50% historic low recorded last Thursday but indicating a narrower expected price swing.

Based on yesterday’s closing options prices, the probability of SpaceX reaching $225 before July next year is under 50%, while the chance of hitting $185 by the end of this month is 54%. Unless the rapid rise of the past two days continues, a new high may take longer to achieve.

Barchart data also show that SpaceX’s put IV is equal to or higher than its call IV, reflecting comparable concern about downside risk. By contrast, Nvidia (NVDA-US) has pricier calls across several expirations, indicating investors are more worried about missing upside moves.

Despite this, yesterday’s options flow for SpaceX remained net‑long. Trader Charles Moon noted that Wall Street seems to be adding to positions starting in Q4, and SpaceX’s recent price action is becoming more synchronized with Tesla (TSLA-US). ThinkOrSwim data show a 30‑day correlation of 0.66 between the two. Jonas adds that, given its growth prospects, SpaceX is one of the relatively cheaper ways to tap the potential of the space and smart‑economy sectors.

items.title: AI客製化晶片與資料中心互連催油門！Marvell喊2031財年營收最高900億美元較法人共識高逾1倍
items.title_en: Custom AI Chips and Data Center Interconnect Drive Growth! Marvell Projects FY2031 Revenue Up to $90 B, Over Double Analyst Consensus
paras: 2026年10月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Marvell Technology(MRVL-US)在紐約投資人日大幅拉高長期成長目標，預計2031財年營收達700億至900億美元，相較截至2026年1月止的2026財年營收82億美元，規模最高接近11倍，背後兩大成長引擎鎖定AI客製化晶片與資料中心互連。
值得注意的是，根據最新法人共識統計，市場原先預估Marvell 2031財年營收約438億美元。以公司提出的700億至900億美元目標計算，分別較法人原先預期高出約60%及105%；即使採目標區間中間值800億美元計算，也高出法人共識約83%，顯示公司對AI資料中心帶動的長期成長預期明顯高於市場原先估計。
執行長Matt Murphy公布長期目標後，Marvell股價盤中一度上漲7.2%至290.82美元。公司股價2026年以來已累計上漲近250%，目前本益比約為未來12個月預估每股盈餘的50倍，市場對AI業務成長已有相當高的期待。
Marvell這次揭露的長期營收結構，也進一步說明AI資料中心需求如何轉化為公司成長。以2031財年700億至900億美元營收目標的中間值800億美元計算，公司預估其中300億美元將來自客製化晶片業務。Marvell目前客製化晶片客戶包括Alphabet(GOOGL-US)與Amazon(AMZN-US)等大型AI雲端業者。
另一個更大的成長來源則是資料中心互連。Marvell預估2031財年interconnect業務營收將達375億美元，涵蓋資料中心內部以及不同資料中心之間傳輸資料所需的網路連接解決方案。
這也補充了Marvell稍早上調2028年營收預測的原因。公司將2028年營收目標由8月提出的180億美元提高至約200億美元，高於LSEG彙整的分析師平均預期182億美元；從此次投資人日揭露的長期產品結構來看，客製化AI晶片與資料中心互連已成為公司擴大AI資料中心營收的主要方向。

paras_en: On October 6, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) dramatically raised its long‑term growth target at its New York investor day, forecasting FY2031 revenue of $70 billion to $90 billion, roughly 8.5‑to‑11 times its FY2026 revenue of $8.2 billion (as of January 2026). The two main growth engines are custom AI chips and data‑center interconnect.

Notably, the latest consensus among sell‑side analysts had originally estimated Marvell’s FY2031 revenue at about $43.8 billion. The company’s $70‑$90 billion range is therefore roughly 60% to 105% higher than that consensus; even the midpoint of $80 billion is about 83% above the prior estimate, indicating Marvell’s expectations for AI‑driven data‑center growth far exceed market expectations.

After CEO Matt Murphy announced the long‑term target, Marvell’s stock rose as much as 7.2% intraday to $290.82. The share price has climbed nearly 250% since the start of 2026, and it now trades at roughly 50 times forward earnings for the next 12 months, reflecting strong market optimism about the AI business.

The disclosed long‑term revenue structure also clarifies how AI data‑center demand translates into company growth. Using the midpoint of the FY2031 target ($80 billion), Marvell estimates $30 billion will come from its custom chip business. Current custom‑chip customers include major AI cloud players such as Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US).

A larger growth source is data‑center interconnect. Marvell projects FY2031 interconnect revenue of $37.5 billion, covering networking solutions needed for data transfer within a data center and between different data centers.

This also explains why Marvell earlier raised its FY2028 revenue outlook. The company lifted its FY2028 target from the $18 billion announced in August to roughly $20 billion, above the LSEG‑averaged analyst forecast of $18.2 billion. From the product mix revealed at the investor day, custom AI chips and data‑center interconnect are now the primary avenues for expanding AI data‑center revenue.

items.title: 美光6億美元和解Netlist專利訴訟取得HBM等記憶體技術5年授權
items.title_en: Micron to Pay $600 Million Settlement with Netlist, Secures 5‑Year License for HBM and Other Memory Technologies
paras: 2026年10月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美光Micron Technology(MU-US)將支付6億美元，與記憶體技術公司Netlist(NLST-US)就記憶體晶片專利爭議達成和解，並取得包含高頻寬記憶體(HBM)技術在內的專利組合5年授權。
依據協議，美光未來5年將每季支付Netlist 3,000萬美元授權費，合計6億美元。雙方此次和解延續多年專利爭議，Netlist先前已於2024年在美國德州聯邦法院取得4.45億美元的專利侵權賠償判決。
隨著HBM成為AI加速器的重要記憶體，美光與Netlist的專利爭議近期也進一步延伸至AI供應鏈。Netlist今年9月向美國國際貿易委員會(ITC)提出新的侵權申訴，尋求阻止涉及相關專利的美光晶片進口，而這些晶片被應用於Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、NVIDIA(NVDA-US)及Broadcom(AVGO-US)的AI運算產品。
Netlist執行長C.K. Hong表示，與美光達成協議進一步驗證公司AI記憶體技術的價值，公司仍將持續保護智慧財產權並投入下一代產品開發。美光截至原文發布時尚未回應這項和解協議。
Netlist今年8月也與Samsung Electronics(005930-KR)就另一項記憶體專利爭議達成和解，此前Netlist已在德州針對Samsung取得合計4.21億美元的專利賠償判決。

paras_en: On October 6, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Micron Technology (MU‑US) will pay $600 million to settle a patent dispute with memory‑technology company Netlist (NLST‑US) and obtain a five‑year license to a portfolio that includes high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) technology.

Under the agreement, Micron will pay Netlist a quarterly royalty of $30 million for the next five years, totaling $600 million. The settlement ends a long‑running patent fight; Netlist previously won a $445 million infringement judgment in the U.S. District Court in Texas in 2024.

As HBM becomes a key memory for AI accelerators, the Micron‑Netlist dispute has recently spilled over into the AI supply chain. In September, Netlist filed a new infringement complaint with the U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) seeking to block imports of Micron chips that use the disputed patents, chips that are employed in AI computing products from Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US).

Netlist CEO C.K. Hong said that reaching an agreement with Micron further validates the value of the company’s AI memory technology; Netlist will continue to protect its intellectual property and invest in next‑generation product development. Micron had not responded to the settlement at the time of publication.

In August of this year, Netlist also settled another memory‑patent dispute with Samsung Electronics (005930‑KR); previously Netlist had secured a $421 million patent‑damage judgment against Samsung in Texas.

items.title: 上網先找Muse？花旗估2030年替Meta帶來逾270億美元年營收
items.title_en: Search the Web with Muse First? Citi Projects Over $27 Billion Annual Revenue for Meta by 2030
paras: 花旗(C-US)看好Meta(META-US)旗下AI助理Muse成為使用者上網的新入口，預估2030年可為Meta帶來逾270億美元年營收。隨著下載量與使用頻率提升，花旗認為，Muse有望憑藉先行者優勢，在新興個人AI代理市場搶占重要地位。
Muse於9月8日推出，累計下載量已突破660萬次，每日活躍使用者達180萬人。花旗指出，新的應用情境陸續出現，加上Meta加強推廣，正帶動產品普及與使用者參與度，讓Muse逐漸成為協助人們搜尋、比較商品及完成線上交易的入口。
花旗預估，到2030年，Muse每年可創造約230億美元交易相關營收，以及約45億美元訂閱營收。這也意味交易服務將是主要收入來源，商業潛力不僅限於向使用者收取訂閱費。
對Meta而言，Muse是將AI個人代理帶向大眾市場的核心產品。公司希望藉此開拓訂閱與商務收入，同時加深使用者在旗下生態系的參與程度，讓AI從偶爾使用的工具，逐漸成為日常生活的一部分。
花旗表示，Muse位居Meta的AI願景核心，目標是融入使用者每天的生活。隨著個人代理能協助處理更多上網活動，這類產品正成為新的網路入口，而Muse的先行優勢可能是競爭關鍵。
不過，競爭對手也積極布局。OpenAI的ChatGPT Dots、Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Gemini，以及Anthropic的Claude，都在擴大AI代理產品布局，爭奪被視為下一個主要消費運算平台的市場。
市場對Muse的期待已反映在股價上。Meta今年以來上漲12.4%，自Muse推出後更累計上漲逾20%，市值逼近2兆美元。花旗的營收預測也凸顯，投資人正關注Meta能否將產品使用熱度轉化為持續收入。
paras_en: Citi (C-US) is bullish on Meta’s (META-US) AI assistant Muse becoming a new entry point for users browsing the web, estimating it could generate more than $27 billion in annual revenue for Meta by 2030. As download volumes and usage frequency rise, Citi believes Muse is poised to leverage its first‑mover advantage to capture a significant share of the emerging personal AI agent market.

Muse was launched on September 8 and has already surpassed 6.6 million cumulative downloads, with daily active users reaching 1.8 million. Citi notes that new use cases are continuously emerging, and Meta’s intensified promotion is driving product adoption and user engagement, gradually turning Muse into a gateway for searching, comparing products, and completing online transactions.

Citi forecasts that by 2030 Muse could generate roughly $23 billion in transaction‑related revenue and about $4.5 billion in subscription revenue each year. This implies that transaction services will be the primary revenue driver, with commercial potential extending beyond merely charging users subscription fees.

For Meta, Muse is the flagship product for bringing AI personal agents to the mass market. The company aims to tap subscription and commerce revenue streams while deepening user participation across its ecosystem, turning AI from an occasional tool into an everyday part of life.

Citi says Muse sits at the core of Meta’s AI vision, with the goal of embedding it into users’ daily routines. As personal agents help handle more online activities, such products are becoming new entry points to the internet, and Muse’s early‑mover advantage could be a key competitive edge.

However, rivals are also moving aggressively. OpenAI’s ChatGPT Dots, Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) Gemini, and Anthropic’s Claude are all expanding their AI agent offerings, vying for what is seen as the next major consumer computing platform market.

Market expectations for Muse are already reflected in Meta’s stock price. The shares have risen 12.4% year‑to‑date and have gained over 20% since Muse’s launch, pushing the market cap close to $2 trillion. Citi’s revenue outlook underscores that investors are watching whether Meta can convert product enthusiasm into sustained earnings.

items.title: 關稅擋不住進口！美國8月貿易逆差衝上1056億美元 創逾一年最大
items.title_en: Tariffs Can't Stop Imports! U.S. August Trade Deficit Swells to $105.6 Billion, Largest in Over a Year
paras: 美國8月貿易逆差擴大至1,056億美元，創2025年初以來最大，且超出市場預期。AI建設帶動半導體與設備進口，加上能源成本上升及關稅政策干擾，推升進口額至歷史新高，貿易恐再度拖累第三季經濟成長。不過，強勁內需也顯示消費與企業投資仍具支撐力。
美國商務部周二(6日)公布，8月商品與服務貿易逆差較前月擴大13.7%，高於市場預估的約1,020億美元，7月逆差則修正為928億美元。8月進口月增4.3%至4,208億美元，出口僅增1.4%至3,152億美元，成長速度明顯落後。

AI建設拉動進口 半導體增額創紀錄

8月商品進口月增5.3%至3,422億美元，商品出口增加2.2%至2,057億美元。經通膨調整後，商品貿易逆差擴大至1,147億美元，為2025年3月以來最大。
包含電腦及周邊、半導體與電信設備的資本財進口，較前月增加62億美元。其中，半導體進口增加24億美元，創單月增額紀錄，民用飛機與電信設備進口也上升，反映AI投資熱潮持續仰賴海外供應。
包含石油及石油產品的工業原料進口增加91億美元，出口增加63億美元，其中原油出口增加20億美元。非貨幣性黃金進出口也同步增加。相較之下，服務出口大致持平，受訪美旅客支出降至2023年8月以來最低拖累。
美國第二季內需增速創逾三年半最快，消費與AI相關設備投資強勁。8月消費支出及核心資本財訂單、出貨數據顯示，這股動能延續至第三季，企業則持續依靠進口滿足需求。

貿易恐續拖累GDP 關稅未阻進口攀升

貿易已連續三季拖累美國國內生產毛額(GDP)，經濟學家估計，第三季拖累幅度可能達2.5個百分點。最新數據公布前，亞特蘭大聯準銀行GDPNow模型估計，淨出口將拉低第三季GDP成長率2.59個百分點，將是2025年初以來最大拖累。
不過，市場對第三季經濟成長率的預估多高於年率3%，預期消費支出可抵銷進口帶來的拖累，優於第二季的2.2%。
川普主張加徵關稅有助縮小逆差，但進口仍持續攀升。關稅變動、戰爭引發的油價波動及供應鏈挑戰，也使未經通膨調整的每月貿易數據劇烈起伏。
分國別來看，美國對加拿大商品逆差擴大至2025年初以來最高。8月貿易談判破局後，兩國企業搶在關稅生效前加速出貨；美國8月22日起對數十億美元加拿大商品課徵50%關稅，加拿大隨後反制。美國對墨西哥、越南的商品逆差均小幅擴大至新高，對半導體重要供應地台灣的逆差也增加。
paras_en: U.S. August trade deficit widened to $105.6 billion, the biggest since early 2025 and above market expectations. AI build‑out drove semiconductor and equipment imports, while higher energy costs and tariff policy disruptions pushed total imports to a historic high, threatening to again drag down third‑quarter economic growth. Nevertheless, strong domestic demand shows consumption and corporate investment remain supportive.

The U.S. Department of Commerce reported on Tuesday (the 6th) that the goods‑and‑services trade deficit for August expanded 13.7% from the prior month, exceeding the market forecast of roughly $102 billion; the July deficit was revised to $92.8 billion.
